property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the FindChangeTransliterateOption (a Application).

property.name: kanaSensitive
property.shortdesc: If true, finds only text that matches the specified kana type.

property.name: widthSensitive
property.shortdesc: If true, finds only text that matches the specified character width.

property.name: includeLockedStoriesForFind
property.shortdesc: If true, includes locked stories in the find query.

property.name: includeLockedLayersForFind
property.shortdesc: If true, includes locked layers in the find query.

property.name: includeHiddenLayers
property.shortdesc: If true, includes hidden layers in the find/change query.

property.name: includeMasterPages
property.shortdesc: If true, includes master pages in the find/change query.

property.name: includeFootnotes
property.shortdesc: If true, includes footnotes in the find/change query.

property.name: wholeWord
property.shortdesc: If true, finds only the complete find text string. If false, also finds strings that contain the find text string.

property.name: caseSensitive
property.shortdesc: If true, finds strings whose use of case matches the find text string. If false, finds strings that match the find text string regardless of case.

property.name: searchBackwards
property.shortdesc: If true, search in the backward direction.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the FindChangeTransliterateOption.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
